title: Daily briefing: ‘A triumph of scientific self-correction’
title_zh: 每日简报：“科学自我纠正的胜利”
abstract: Explore how researchers debunked race science. Plus, pressure put on your bones by exercise might slow ageing and watch a snake do a forward roll to escape danger.
abstract_zh: 探讨研究人员如何驳斥伪科学的种族研究。此外，运动对骨骼产生的压力可能延缓衰老，并观察蛇类如何通过前空翻逃离危险。
